title: Greener alternatives for synthesis of isoquinoline and its derivatives: a comparative review of eco-compatible synthetic routes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30231-30275
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04962H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shivani Kirad, P. R. Deepa, Murugesan Sankaranarayanan
This review highlights green synthesis of isoquinolines via photocatalysis, microwave-assisted, metal-free, solvent-free methods, and recyclable catalysts, emphasizing atom economy, low toxicity, energy efficiency, and minimal waste.
